recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring a solid matte black background with vibrant neon green graphic elements positioned in the corners, utilizing a 3D beveled effect on both typography and a central botanical icon.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between deep black negative space and luminous green elements
Diagonal balance between top-left text and bottom-right icon/text cluster
Consistent beveled and embossed treatment across all green graphics
coreInvariants: Vibrant lime/neon green primary accent color
Beveled edge effect with inner highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Elements are pushed to the extreme corners, leaving a massive central void of negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bottom-right corner containing the botanical icon and numeric text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, moves diagonally through the black void, and settles on the bottom-right graphic cluster.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; occupies approximately 85% of the frame to create a sense of focus and intensity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Matte black background for depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon green for all primary graphic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and light green for highlights and bevel effects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation green against zero-value black creates a glowing, digital effect.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerals are blocky and digital in nature
Letters feature a distinct inner 'ridge' created by the beveling
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or geometric sans-serif for secondary metadata to maintain a technical, digital look.
graphicDevices: Symmetrical botanical leaf icon with serrated edges and central vein highlights
Rectangular advisory badge in the lower-left quadrant

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square geometric skeleton of the display text.
Provides a similar technical and blocky feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid matte black square canvas. In the bottom right, place a symmetrical, stylized 7-pointed serrated leaf icon in neon green with a heavy 3D bevel and inner glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top-left corner and numeric text to the right of the leaf icon. Apply a matching neon green color and 3D bevel effect to all text. Place a small black and white rectangular warning label in the bottom-left.

verificationChecks: Do all green elements share the same 3D bevel treatment?
Is the central area of the composition completely empty?
Are the text elements pushed toward the edges?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphics

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleeding between green and black
Ensure bevel highlights are consistent in direction
Confirm text is legible despite the 3D effect
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black background + corner-anchored beveled neon graphics + wide geometric sans-serif + massive central negative space.
